name: The Wonderland Killings
source:
Up until now, Stagbluff has not been a city of particular note. 

A smaller mining town built in the depths of the Great Valley, its community is fairly tight-knit. However, The Magic Circle is looking to shake up that status quo. A glorious tourist attraction, The Magic Circle is a hotel constructed entirely underground which houses several 'Adventure Zones,' areas created to facilitate storybook-like adventures for Guests to explore! The entire experience is run by a state-of-the-art A.I. by the name Campbell, a program designed to give Guests a truly immersive stay. To drum up excitement, The Gatzs (the owners of the hotel), have decided to host a Sneek Peak Event, where various members of the town can get an exclusive early look at the hotel before it opens to the wider public. 

Janette Ire, lawyer/fixer for the Gatzs, has been tasked with making sure the Sneek Peek Event goes off without a hitch, and for looking out for the twins, Nikky and Kerry Gatz. Unfortunately, things take a turn for the worse when Campbell's code is hacked, and suddenly those underground become hostages to some unknown mastermind. Trapped, unless they decide to take advantage of a very deadly rule...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4097660/The_Wonderland_Killings/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
到目前为止，斯塔格布拉夫还不是一座特别值得注意的城市。

这是一个建在大峡谷深处的较小的采矿小镇，其社区关系相当紧密。然而，The Magic Circle正在寻求改变这一现状。魔法圈是一个光荣的旅游景点，是一家完全建在地下的酒店，其中设有多个“冒险区”，这些区域的创建是为了方便客人探索故事书般的冒险！整个体验由最先进的人工智能运行。名为Campbell的项目旨在为宾客提供真正身临其境的住宿体验。为了激发人们的兴奋感，盖茨夫妇（酒店的所有者）决定举办斯内克峰活动，镇上的各种成员可以在酒店向更广泛的公众开放之前提前独家参观酒店。

珍妮特·艾尔 (Janette Ire) 是盖茨夫妇的律师/掮客，她的任务是确保Sneek Peek活动顺利进行，并照顾双胞胎Nikky和 ​​Kerry Gatz。不幸的是，当坎贝尔的代码被黑客入侵时，事情变得更糟，突然那些地下组织成为了某个未知策划者的人质。被困住了，除非他们决定利用一个非常致命的规则……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4097660/The_Wonderland_Killings/]Steam[/url]]
